## Hallway images 1.15.0 and 1.15.1 are unverified

`ghcr.io/living-proof-labs/capability-verifier-hallway:1.15.0` and `:1.15.1` stay published
(version tags are never retagged) but are unpinned and unverified. 1.15.0's index was pushed
before the platform check, which then failed on the buildx attestation manifests. 1.15.1's
release-notes step could not edit the release (the merge job lacked `contents: write`), so the
native per-arch 12/20 check never ran. Use 1.15.2 (index digest below).
